prompt:
Use case: compositing; identity-preserve.
Create one SQUARE 1:1 polished photographic promotional artwork panel, 1080 x 1080, which will become the middle of a 1080x1920 ChartFanatics Instagram Story. Output ONLY the square artwork, not a full Story mockup. Separate exact brand header and footer will be composited later.
Image 1 is the approved thumbnail to faithfully adapt, Image 2 is the client's OWN Story reference, and the subsequent photographs are the original HD facial identity / natural skin references. Copy the reference's composition logic and simple high-impact photography, typography and highlight boxes. Do not bring across the old guest, old text or money claims.
The top and bottom edges of this square panel must fade subtly to near-black #0c0c0c, so the artwork joins a black Story background without visible seams. Fill the square richly with the scene and large readable title. No logo, no footer, no guest-name line, no YouTube account text in this panel. No enclosing frame or mockup.
CRITICAL photographic fidelity: extract/use the real photo faces from the original photographs, with softly even, slightly brighter exposure and natural skin hue. Preserve actual likeness, facial structure, expression, hair, eyebrows and beard. No etched wrinkles, no invented pores, no plastic skin, no wax, no over-sharpening or painted hair. The thumbnail is a layout/clothing reference, never authority for skin texture. Use a restrained real camera finish with natural fine detail. No microphones, microphone arms or cables. No grain/noise yet (5% monochrome grain will be added once at final export). Hands anatomically natural, no duplicated fingers. Poppins-like geometric sans serif: regular/medium weight for supporting words, bold only for highlighted key phrases. All text exact, within 45px horizontal safe margins. Keep text away from eyes.

Specific composition:
Adapt thumbnail 01 using the laptop/right-side portrait composition of Story reference 2. Upper small yellow badge exactly "Order Flow Explained". Large Bookmap laptop on LEFT with the exact dual-pane colorful order-flow screen from thumbnail 1, real readable screenshot texture. Scott on RIGHT in a neutral WHITE polo, looking at camera, his head much larger than the laptop keys but leave the main chart visible. Preserve his original face. One yellow curved arrow points to the laptop chart. Photo scene takes roughly y100-800. At bottom, two centered headline lines at y800-1030: "WHAT CANDLES" then "DON'T SHOW"; CANDLES black bold on white rounded rectangle, other words white medium. Red light left, restrained green accent behind Scott. No extra words.
